entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, hello. I'm calling about my VeloBand GPS tracker. I think I need to return it, but I'm just so confused by everything on the website.
I can certainly look into a return for you. To make sure I understand correctly, is it a technical fault with the device or more of a personal preference?
Oh, it turns on and everything. It's just... not what I expected. I got overwhelmed with all the features. I was looking at the rules and got worried it was already too late to send back.
I see. Let me just pull up your order details. One moment. Okay, I see the VeloBand was delivered to you 20 days ago.
Yes, that sounds right. I was worried because of, you know, hygiene and things like that with wearable items. I just figured it was a lost cause. Can't you just help me?
I completely understand the concern about sanitation with a device that's worn on the skin. However, let me check the official policy for your specific product.
Okay, I've confirmed it. For the VeloBand GPS Tracker, our company policy actually allows for returns up to 90 days after delivery, as long as it's in its original condition.
Wait, really? 90 days? Oh, that's such a relief! So I'm not too late?
Not at all. You're well within the window. I can go ahead and process that return for you right now. I've just sent a prepaid shipping label to the email address we have on file.
Wow, that was so easy. Thank you so much, Charlie! I really appreciate your help.
You're very welcome. Once we receive the item, you'll see a full refund processed within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
